verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents webhooks that notify the platform when a resource changes status, and lets you subscribe to events across a listed set of resources. It also offers an on-premises integration guide for private networks without a public endpoint, plus a no-code Zapier path triggered by events such as a merchant application moving to Needs Information. Missing for 10: evidence of webhook signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees and a detailed event catalog, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
